explanation: Every extra subsumption, 7 direct edges and 14 entailed subsumptions in all, follows from InverseObjectProperties(BFO_0000050 part_of, BFO_0000051 has_part), the one GO axiom outside OWL 2 EL, which the classifier and ELK leave out and report, with TransitiveObjectProperty(part_of), GO_0043227 membrane-bounded organelle EquivalentTo organelle and has_part some membrane, and GO_0031090 organelle membrane EquivalentTo membrane and part_of some GO_0043227. For GO_0031527 filopodium membrane: it is a membrane and part_of some GO_0030175 filopodium, which is part_of some GO_0015629 actin cytoskeleton, an organelle. By transitivity the membrane is part of an actin cytoskeleton, by the inverse that cytoskeleton has the membrane as a part, so it is a membrane-bounded organelle and the membrane an organelle membrane. GO_0031528 and GO_0060171 follow the same path through GO_0015629, GO_0034357 and GO_0035448 through GO_0009579 thylakoid, and GO_0035448 then falls under GO_0031312. The two other differences are direct edges of the classifier that these subsumptions make indirect.
